Tailgating. There are many layers to this age old American past time. I don't know what those layer are. But I want to do it. What could be more fun than drinking with strangers in a car park for six hours, so that the football game you paid hundreds of dollars to attend becomes a vague memory, buried under a hangover and a deep sense of anxiety and regret?
